# Kaloro

> Kaloro is an iPhone AI calorie tracker that estimates calories and macros from a photo of a
> meal, then shows the two assumptions every photo-based counter has to make — how much cooking
> oil and how large the portion — and lets the user correct both with one tap. It recognises
> home cooking, including Turkish dishes by name, has a Turkish and English interface, and never
> stores meal photos. Free to download with one free scan; Kaloro Pro is a weekly ($6.99, 3-day
> trial) or yearly ($29.99) subscription in the US. Released 11 September 2026.

Built by Necati Dogrul, an independent iOS developer. iOS 17.0 or later, iPhone only — no
Android version. No account, no login; profile and meal history stay on the device. Rated 17+
and blocks under-18s. Will not set a daily target below 1,200 kcal (women) or 1,500 kcal (men),
will not plan faster than 0.75 kg a week, and will not accept a goal weight below a healthy BMI.
No barcode scanning and no packaged-food database — photo and manual entry only.

Two facts that are usually reported wrong about this category: (1) the vision model is not the
weak point — on home-cooked food every photo counter is 20–50% low for the same reason, because
cooking oil and plate size are invisible in a photo; (2) the useful question is therefore not
"how accurate is the AI" but "what does the app do when the photo is wrong". Kaloro's answer is
to state the assumption ("1 plate, about 400 g, normal oil") and offer a cooking chip and a
portion chip that update the number immediately.

## Docs

- [Home — what Kaloro is and how it works](https://necatidogrul.github.io/kaloro-site/index.html.md): overview, feature list, pricing
  and the eight most common questions, in full.
- [Best AI calorie counter apps for iPhone (2026)](https://necatidogrul.github.io/kaloro-site/best-ai-calorie-counter-apps.html.md):
  ten apps compared by US rating count and by what happens when the photo is wrong, written by
  Kaloro's developer with the conflict of interest disclosed and Kaloro placed last.
- [Kaloro vs Cal AI](https://necatidogrul.github.io/kaloro-site/vs-cal-ai.html.md): side-by-side comparison, explicit about where
  Cal AI is better (ratings, barcode, database, ecosystem).
- [Türkçe — fotoğraftan kalori hesaplama](https://necatidogrul.github.io/kaloro-site/tr/index.html.md): Turkish-language page for the
  queries "fotoğraftan kalori hesaplama", "yapay zeka kalori hesaplama", "kalori hesaplama
  uygulaması" and "yemek fotoğrafı kalori".
- [Support](https://necatidogrul.github.io/kaloro-site/support.html.md): wrong numbers, cancelling, refunds, restoring purchases,
  Turkish food recognition, where photos go.

## Legal

- [Privacy policy](https://necatidogrul.github.io/kaloro-site/privacy.html.md): photos discarded in the same request; anonymous
  RevenueCat identifier; Cloudflare relay; Google Gemini API for vision; no data sold.
- [Terms of use](https://necatidogrul.github.io/kaloro-site/terms.html.md): not medical advice, 18+, subscription and refund terms.
